row.notes: (rec, status u8, reason u8) on a session result record R: request a final status. Skipped when a pending request (R+0x11f flag) already has status >= new or R+0x18 state already equals it; else R+0x11d=status, R+0x11e=reason, R+0x11f=1. Logs SESSION-RESULT 'Vehicle %d requested status %s.%s' with names from table 0x14565c1f8 (0 eInvalid,1 eInactive,2 eActive,3 eFinished,4 eDidNotFinish,5 eDisqualified,6 eNotClassified,7 eRetired). Every ruleset inlines the same logic. Result record R: +0 vehicle id, +0x8^+0x10 laps (XOR), +0x18 state, +0x28^+0x30 race time f64, +0x38^+0x40 extra/score time f64, +0x48^+0x50 position, +0x58^+0x60 class position, +0xe8^+0xf0, +0xf8^+0x100, +0x108^+0x110 byte, +0x124 timer-expired flag, +0x125 winner flag. Reasons seen: 1 retired, 2 finished, 4 inactive, 6 DSQ, 7 finished after time expiry, 9 left online lobby. Addon: request DSQ/DNF/retired then commit with Sess_Result_ChangeVehicleStatus 0x142c7bae0.
